messages.budget.strategy.hybrid.title: Hybrid
messages.budget.strategy.hybrid.description: Flexible mode: combine category limits, an overall budget and savings goals to suit your household. Useful when income or expenses vary.
messages.budget.strategy.zeroBased.title: Zero-Based Budgeting
messages.budget.strategy.zeroBased.description: Give every expected euro a job before the month begins. Allocate expected income to categories and savings until the unallocated amount is as close to €0 as possible.
messages.budget.strategy.envelope.title: Envelope budgeting
messages.budget.strategy.envelope.description: Give each expense category a fixed envelope. HaushaltPro shows how much has been used and how much remains in every envelope.
messages.budget.strategy.503020.title: 50/30/20 rule
messages.budget.strategy.503020.description: Guideline for net income: 50% needs, 30% wants and 20% savings/reserves. Assign budgets to the Needs, Wants or Savings buckets.
messages.budget.strategy.pyf.title: Pay Yourself First
messages.budget.strategy.pyf.description: Savings come first. Reserve a budget in the Savings/Reserves bucket before allocating the remaining expected income to expenses.
messages.recurring.label: Recurring
messages.reports.flowHelp: Income on the left, the balance/net amount in the middle, and outflows on the right for the selected month or year.

legacy.Was HaushaltPro macht, wie du sinnvoll s: What HaushaltPro does, how to get started and how documentation and forecasts work together.
legacy.HaushaltPro dokumentiert echte Buchungen: HaushaltPro documents real transactions and calculates liquidity from future individual transactions and recurring series. The month opening is always the balance immediately before transactions on day 1.
legacy.Lege pro Bankkonto, Bargeldkonto oder Za: Create an account for each bank account, cash account or payment service with a start date and opening balance. If needed, you can later correct the month opening for any month without rewriting historical transactions.
legacy.Kategorien bestimmen eindeutig die Art e: Categories clearly define a transaction as expense, income or savings, keeping reports and savings rates consistent.
legacy.Eine Buchung erhält einen Namen, optiona: A transaction has a name and optionally a payee, note and tags. Payees are stored as suggestions only when requested. Internal transfers move money between your own accounts without counting as household income or expense. Enable “Recurring” for rent, salary, savings plans, etc.
legacy.Dashboard und Planung verwenden bekannte: Dashboard and planning use known future transactions and series. “Fixed”, “probable” and “estimated” control conservative and optimistic scenarios.
legacy.Der Finanz-Check prüft unter anderem SQL: The Finance Check tests SQLCipher integrity, month transitions, splits, series, account reconciliation, audit chain and attachment storage. Review warnings and correct errors promptly.
legacy.Belege werden nur gespeichert, wenn du s: Attachments are stored only when explicitly uploaded to a transaction. Default limits: 5 MB per file, 10 files per transaction and 100 MB total. Reaching the limit blocks further uploads only; existing data remains unchanged.
legacy.„Verschlüsseltes Backup herunterladen“ e: “Download encrypted backup” creates a portable .hpb file. “Create internal backup & apply rotation” additionally stores a local snapshot in the Docker volume and keeps 7 daily, 4 weekly and 12 monthly generations.
legacy.Unter Einstellungen zeigt die Audit-Time: In Settings, the audit timeline shows which user made which change and when. Entries are stored in the encrypted SQLCipher database – not the Docker/system log – and form part of a hash chain.
legacy.Eigentümer können Benutzer direkt in den: Owners can create users, assign roles and reset forgotten passwords directly in Settings. Permissions apply per household book. Each household book has its own SQLCipher database, so a shared household and a child’s household book can be kept separate.
legacy.Die Einstellungen zeigen die Größe der a: Settings show the size of the current database and attachment storage. Transactions can be deleted by date range or entirely. Before bulk deletion, HaushaltPro shows the number of matches; final confirmation requires entering “DELETE” exactly.
legacy.HaushaltPro bindet standardmäßig nur an: By default HaushaltPro binds to localhost only. For access from your trusted LAN/VPN:
legacy.Für eine öffentliche Domain solltest du: For a public domain, do not expose port 8080 directly; use an HTTPS reverse proxy and set SECURE_COOKIES=true.
